text: Implemented RigidObjectiveLinearization.scala plus explicit physical oracle tests; added a checked-to-unchecked rigid Jacobian hot path and routed robust correlation through one implementation. Both reframe4s-flashalignJVM/test and reframe4s-flashalignJS/test passed 39/39 under strict Scala 3.7.4 compilation. Independent physical phantom with positive and negative polarity, constant fixed contrast, and outside support agreed at objective 2e-12, all six gradient entries 2e-11, and all 36 GN entries 3e-11. Tests verify 6 parameters/21 packed entries, result and scratch reuse, frozen objective/geometry cache IDs, transform-sensitive cache invalidation, workspace ownership, exact interpolation/read counters, invalid-cost retention, posterior-mass accounting, and data-only information summaries. The rigid path imports no HalfFlow or nonlinear execution type and instantiates no basis, dense warp, Krylov state, or generic geometry dispatch. Ownership passed at 1155 public names/64 canonical owners; PRD/build graph passed 148 IDs/27 nodes/94 edges; tracked and new-file whitespace checks were clean. Provider pins remain the B01-qualified hashes.
